architecture: PP-OCRv4 text recognizer (ONNX, CTC decoding); production engine, used without its detector
CRNN: 6-conv VGG-style CNN (height 32) + 2-layer BiLSTM(256) + CTC, greedy decoding; trained from scratch on 40438 train crops (102 chars), best epoch 9 of 17, val CER 0.061
TrOCR-small-printed: ViT-style image encoder + Transformer text decoder with cross-attention (microsoft/trocr-small-printed), pretrained checkpoint, zero fine-tuning here, greedy decoding
note: the public TrOCR printed checkpoints were fine-tuned on SROIE; our SROIE documents may have been seen -> treat the SROIE subset as non-comparable
